text:
elaine: Heads-up — docs PR for /generate shows empty optional fields in the request examples which might confuse users. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4582

sam: Ack. Can we default to minimal examples that omit empty/null optional fields? Much easier to follow.

mike: I updated the Python snippet locally to not include an empty `context` field. Minimal example could be:
```python
client.generate(model=\"gpt-xx\", input=\"hi\")
```
Should we show both minimal + expanded?

jess: I think show minimal by default and put an "Expanded example" accordion with the full JSON body. Also add a migration note for SDK users about empty-field serialization.

elaine: Agreed. I'll modify the PR to replace the full-body example with the minimal one and add a short note: "When optional fields are empty, omit them to reduce noise and prevent confusion with default behavior." Anyone volunteer to review?

sam: :eyes: I'll take a quick pass this afternoon. Need to double-check the TypeScript snippets (naming + optional chaining).

mike: Also a reminder — keep the example responses aligned with the minimal request shape. Some of the server-side validation examples reference fields we plan to omit.

jess: And please check the Go snippet — it currently initializes empty slices/structs which serializes to `[]` or `{}` instead of omitting the key. That causes a mismatch with minimal examples. Recommend using `omitempty` tags in the sample struct or explicitly not setting optional fields in the example.

docs-bot: PR #4582 opened by elaine: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4582 — includes minimal examples + migration note. CI: running.

elaine: Thanks. @sam @mike @jess please add comments on the PR by EOD. I'll merge after 2 approvals + green CI.

sam: Added a small comment about `max_tokens` vs `max_new_tokens` naming in the examples — want to keep the API-ref consistent with the SDK aliases.

mike: Left LGTM + one nit about missing language tags on the fenced code blocks (python -> ```python).

jess: Left one suggestion for the Go snippet to show a pointer-based omission pattern (`*string` + nil) so we avoid showing empty values.

elaine: :thumbsup: planning to merge once CI is green. If anyone finds downstream SDK snippet mismatches after merge, ping this channel and I'll follow up.
